status: PRE-REGISTERED before any training or test-bank run. Do not edit after the first test evaluation; amendments go to criteria_amendments.json with reason + timestamp.

designs.A: CA-UNOMP: condition-adaptive decoder unfolded from NOMP (Mamandipoor et al. 2016) / quantised NOMP-ML (GNOMP); 921,842 params; trained, primary design
designs.B: HU-NOMP: hyper-conditioned unfolded NOMP (learned hyperparameters, seeds, stopping; no learned step MLP, no learned selector); 517,103 params; trained, secondary design and ablation
designs.C: posterior-mass decoder for ideal hardware; NOT trained (diag: legal headroom <= +0.0008 vs os8rc6, separation prior -0.03* when violated)

claim_rules.metric: pd_paper (|err|<=1 deg per angle component, mean over SNR groups) via new_results/common.py scene_stats/metric_by_snr; strict Pd and RMSE reported alongside; unknown-L cells use hit-F1 = 2*hits/(n_true+n_est) with Hungarian matching
claim_rules.stats: paired bootstrap, 2000 resamples within SNR groups, seed 0; a win/loss requires the 95% CI to exclude 0; family-level Holm-adjusted win counts reported as sensitivity
claim_rules.selection: one checkpoint per design, chosen only on the validation mix (seed 71_200_000); no test bank used for any choice; designs A and B are both reported whatever the outcome
claim_rules.wording: decoder must be described as 'unfolded from NOMP (Mamandipoor et al. 2016)'; NOMP and the strongest classical variants stay named baselines; any gain traced to the benchmark prior is labelled a prior exploit
claim_rules.L_protocol: official and regime cells: true L given to every method; unknown-L tests: no method is given L

measures: G0a: share of failing scenes where ML-from-truth reaches lower exact quantised NLL than 13-start ML (b1/15, b2/15, b1/0, b2/0; 200 scenes each)
G0b: classical annealed ML (kappa 3->1) Pd vs 13-start ML
G0c: oracle Pd over the classical hypothesis pool H1-H6
gate_G0.decision: if G0a < 10% in all four cells AND G0c oracle < +0.02 over ML in all four cells: drop A's learned selector (A = B + step MLP) and report; classical annealed ML is a named baseline in all cases

PRIMARY.bank: official frozen eval_bank, 8000 scenes, L=3 given, ideal hardware
requires_all: no SNR in {10,15,20,25} dB with A - NOMP os8rc6 CI entirely < 0
fresh ideal replicate (seed 9520, 4000 scenes): A - NOMP os8rc6 point estimate > 0
PRIMARY.prediction: FAIL vs os8rc6 expected (diag: best legal mechanism +0.0007 n.s. over os8rc6); pass vs os4rc3 plausible (+0.0015)

S1_regime_vs_best_classical.baseline: best classical per cell, chosen on the test bank itself, classical methods given the TRUE SNR/noise variance and true impairment model: NOMP os4rc3, NOMP os8rc6, NOMP+tuned SC, consistent NOMP, quantised ML 13 starts + EM, classical annealed ML, EB-ML-g5, PN-ML, POS-MAP
S1_regime_vs_best_classical.decoder_inputs: Y, ADC bits b and AGC type, L; NOT the SNR, NOT the impairment type/level
S1_regime_vs_best_classical.pass: >= 7 of 14 cells with A - best classical CI > 0, AND no cell with A - best classical point estimate < -0.02 and CI < 0, AND S2 holds
S1_regime_vs_best_classical.prediction: expected FAIL on the count (likely wins: M5_b1_snr15, M2_0.2_snr15; predicted losses: M3 cells vs EB-ML-g5, M1)

S1b_regime_vs_deployable_classical.baseline: one fixed bit-aware classical pipeline not told SNR or impairment: b<=4 -> quantised ML (13 starts + EM) with classical joint noise-std estimation; b=inf -> NOMP os8rc6 + tuned SC
S1b_regime_vs_deployable_classical.pass: >= 10 of 14 cells with CI > 0 and no significant loss in any cell

S2_official_noninferiority.pass: A - NOMP os8rc6 on the official bank: lower 95% CI bound > -0.002, and no SNR >= 10 dB with CI entirely < 0

S3_snr_mismatch.pass: A beats quantised ML with assumed SNR = true+5 dB AND true-5 dB (CI > 0) in >= 6 of 8 cells

banks: fresh L-mixed seed 9550 (L uniform 1..6, SNR -10..25, 2000 scenes)
S4_unknown_L.baseline: NOMP with its residual-threshold stopping (P_fa 0.01) using true sigma, and using classically estimated sigma; threshold of each tuned on validation only
S4_unknown_L.pass: A hit-F1 - best of those baselines CI > 0 on the L-mixed bank AND in >= 6 of the 10 cached cells, with false-alarm rate not higher than the baseline's by > 0.02

S5_latency.pass: A median <= 120 ms per scene (1 thread, batch 1) and below multi-start quantised ML (482 ms); batch-256 throughput reported

banks: fresh nosep seed 9560 and sep10 seed 9561 (L=3, -10/-5/0/5 dB, 1000 each)
cached L1/L2/L4/L5/L6 0/15 dB with L given
H1_prior_violation.pass: A - NOMP os4rc3 never has CI entirely below -0.01 on any of these banks; every loss is reported; if the official-bank gain shrinks by > 50% on nosep/sep10 relative to the official bank at the same SNRs, the official gain is labelled a benchmark-prior exploit

HONESTY.H2_no_prior_features: no pairwise-separation or gain-ordering feature in any learned input (checked by code listing in the report)
H3_OOD_report_only: ADC SNR sweep b1/b2 at -5,5,10,25 dB (seeds 9530-9537)
H4_attribution: A with true sigma instead of sigma_hat
A with lowest-NLL selection instead of learned selector
hybrid (ML from FT-network seeds) shown as prior best system
HONESTY.H5_null_reporting: every failed criterion is reported plainly in the report and summary; no cell, bank or variant is added or dropped after the first test evaluation

OUTCOME_LABELS.FULL: P1 and S1 and S2 pass
OUTCOME_LABELS.REGIME_ONLY: S2 passes and (S1 or S1b or S3 or S4) passes; P1 fails
OUTCOME_LABELS.NULL: otherwise (incl. S2 fail = regression on the official bank)
